name: MUSES03 / MUSES03D
type: JFET-input audio single, two-chip MUSES flagship
tagline: New JRC's 2017 two-die MUSES flagship single with 0.00003% THD, loved for vocal presence; discontinued in 2023.

lineage.note: Samples announced 2016-10-11 (from Dec 2016); sales from 2017-03-24 (JP) / 2017-03-28 (EN). Proprietary, no second source.
New JRC became Nisshinbo in 2022. Akizuki restocks c. 2021-07 and 2022-11; discontinued by 2023-10-18.

part_numbers.note: Only vendor code. DIP8(MUSES), marking '03', Sn-2Bi, 470 mg, sticks of 10; DigiKey 10671518.
Akizuki catalog name (g111843 / I-11843), not a vendor code; same silicon.

key_specs.condition: GB at 10 kHz; fT at Av=+100

key_specs.value: 250 mA peak (abs max); −V swing falls above ~150 mA
IB 5 pA typ / 250 pA max; IIO 2 / 220 pA
JFET; separate input- and output-stage dies; OFC lead frame

reputation.summary: Launch press (Stereo Sound, EE Times Japan) stressed the two-die design and 0.00003% THD. Head-Fi posters praise its midrange and deliberately 'slow' presentation that gives vocals physical presence; neutral, slightly darker than the OPA828 or AD797BRZ. MUSES05 is seen as faster and airier, MUSES03 as fuller-bodied. One Japanese blogger heard no difference from MUSES05. No independent bench measurements.
typical_uses: Preamps, line amps and active filters
Rolling: two singles on a dual-DIP8 adapter
caveats: Single, DIP8 only: dual sockets need two parts on an adapter, about 20 mA max per socket.
Output asymmetric under heavy load: ≈−10 V into 50 Ω, ≈−6 V at 250 mA vs ≈+12.8 V.
250 mA abs max: datasheet advises a series protection resistor (≥90 Ω at 18 V) where shorts are possible.
Vos 1.0 mV typ, no max; Ib reaches nA above about 90 °C; differential input only ±6 V.
Discontinued 2023; remaining stock trades on auctions where counterfeit MUSES parts circulate.

counterfeit_notes: Datasheet warns fakes circulate, often visually identical; buy authorized. Genuine: marking '03', DIP8 body 8.8 × 6.4 mm, OFC frame, Sn-2Bi, 470 mg. Post-2023 auction stock is risky; check SR+ ≈37 / SR− ≈102 V/µs, Iq ≈5.8 mA.

silicon_changes.summary: Nisshinbo discontinued the MUSES03; it was on the discontinued list by 18 Oct 2023 (blog, updated 25 Oct). Stock reappeared briefly in Oct 2023; end of sales confirmed by Jan 2024. A June 2024 factory-visit post suggests process reasons, unconfirmed. MUSES01/02 stayed in production; no successor named.
silicon_changes.identification: Any new-stock MUSES03 offered after early 2024 is remaining inventory or counterfeit.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: No silicon change; supply has ended and no successor with the same sound has been named.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: medium: no drop-in replacement named; finite stock; auction listings carry counterfeit risk.
silicon_changes.verification: Blog post, factory-visit report and 生産終了 marketplace listings agree; vendor's discontinued list not seen directly.

'MUSES Flagship Operational Amplifier MUSES03 has begun selling'; EN release dated 2017-03-28.
Only JP version found (PDF metadata 2017-04-27 / 2017-05-01); njr.co.jp footer; no printed change log.

claims_confirmed: Listed as discontinued (生産終了品) by 2023-10-18 (https://iiikun15a.blog.jp/archives/22108332.html).
nw-electric 2024-06 factory visit covers the discontinuation (https://nw-electric.way-nifty.com/blog/2024/06/post-6f35c5.html).
EN news 'MUSES Flagship Operational Amplifier MUSES03', 2017-03-28 (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/njr/2017/semi_20170328.html).
English datasheet is Ver.4.2 with njr.com footer (https://www.pawpaw.cn/media/documents/2022-01/MUSES03.pdf).
Legacy NJR English datasheet URL indexed (https://www.njr.com/electronic_device/PDF/MUSES03_E.pdf).
alldatasheet copy: 11 pages, 844 KB, '03' marking page (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/1244750/NJRC/MUSES03.html).
5.8 mA per channel, about 0.2 W for two parts at ±15 V (https://electronics.alibaba.com/buyingguides/muses03-op-amp-guide-when-to-use-it-when-to-skip).
Head-Fi: midrange and 'slow' vocal presence, darker than OPA828; MUSES05 faster, airier (https://www.head-fi.org/threads/the-opamp-thread.432749/page-494).
diyAudio thread 'Muses03, warmer and livelier opamp' exists (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/muses03-warmer-and-livelier-opamp-tips-and-advice.415987/).
refuted_claims: 'English datasheet not located' is refuted: an EN Ver.4.2 edition exists; legacy path njr.com/electronic_device/PDF/MUSES03_E.pdf.
'MUSES03D follows NJR's D = DIP habit' is refuted: it is Akizuki's catalog name (g111843).
